entities.name: Bhawani Singh, Crown Prince of Jaipur
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brigadier Maharaja Sawai Bhawani Singh MVC was an officer in the Indian Army and an entrepreneur. He was last official Maharaja of Jaipur from 1970-1971.
